stack: nuqs (URL state adapter for App Router)
sharp (devDependency, image processing for build-time manifest)
TypeScript 5 (tsconfig.json, next-env.d.ts, proxy.ts — project is otherwise JS/JSX)
custom Node http server (server.js) alongside standard next dev/start
detected_patterns: i18n (4 locales pt/en/fr/es via next-intl, routing.jsx pathnames + MENU_CATEGORY_SLUGS, middleware in proxy.ts)
caching (Next.js 16 'use cache' directive + cacheLife/cacheTag in lib/cache.jsx, cacheComponents:true in next.config.js)
structured-data/schema.org (lib/jsonld.js builds Restaurant, Organization, WebSite, Menu, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage JSON-LD)
static-site-generation (generateStaticParams in app/[locale]/layout.jsx and app/[locale]/menu/[slug]/page.jsx for locale x category cartesian product)
seo/aio (app/sitemap.js, app/robots.js, app/llms.txt/route.js, components/Seo.js, security headers in next.config.js)
file-based content (no CMS — all copy in messages/{locale}/*.json, gallery in content/gallery.json, no database/ORM found)

image-pipeline (public/images/ indexed by a build-image-manifest script referenced in package.json predev/prebuild into lib/imageManifest.json — script file itself was NOT found under scripts/, see note in key_files)

directory_summary.purpose: Next.js App Router tree: root layout, the [locale]-scoped route group (/, /menu, /menu/[slug], /pizzarte, /galeria, /contactos), global 404, and route handlers/metadata files (sitemap.js, robots.js, llms.txt/route.js, fonts.js).
Locale-scoped page tree for the 4 supported locales (pt default, en, fr, es), each page a Server Component that builds SEO metadata + JSON-LD and delegates rendering to PageShell.

All UI split by domain (about/, header/, footer/, menu/, chess/, contact/, animation/, popup/, layout/) plus Seo.js and the shared styled-components style module; each merges the old Gatsby desktop+mobile variants into one responsive component.

next-intl configuration: locale/pathname routing table + menu category slug translations (routing.jsx), locale-aware Link/useRouter/getPathname wrappers (navigation.jsx), canonical nav link translation (navLinks.js), and per-request message loading (request.jsx).

Cross-cutting utilities: schema.org JSON-LD builders (jsonld.js), cached message loading via Next.js 'use cache' (cache.jsx), styled-components SSR registry (StyledRegistry.jsx), legacy Gatsby URL redirect table (legacyMenuRedirects.js), and the generated image manifest (imageManifest.json).

Custom React hooks that defer loading animation libraries (gsap, anime.js) and read a responsive breakpoint, deliberately importing gsap/anime inside the effect body (never at top-level import) to avoid breaking static prerendering.

Small standalone helpers: popup React Context (PopupContext.js), consent-gated GA tag helper (consentGtag.js), phone link handling (handlePhone.js), and a prefers-reduced-motion check (prefersReducedMotion.js).
All site copy for 4 locales (pt/en/fr/es), one JSON file per page-ish namespace (home, menu, pizzarte, contact) — the sole content source, no CMS.
Static gallery.json extracted once from WordPress (scripts/fetch-gallery.mjs, referenced in CLAUDE.md but not found on disk) — no WordPress runtime dependency remains.
All site imagery (Homepage/, Menu/, galeria/, plus an _originals/ subtree of pre-optimization source images), indexed by a build-time manifest script into lib/imageManifest.json.
Legal/consumer documents served as static PDFs (privacy policy, terms & conditions, consumer info, project fact sheet), each duplicated for PT and EN.
Homepage hero video and its poster image.
Local font files (BritishRegular, ChunkyRosieDemo) loaded via next/font/local in app/fonts.js.

Portuguese-language SEO/GEO/AIO methodology knowledge base for the agency (fundamentals, SEO, AIO, GEO, structured data, search types, role-based guides, conclusions) — general methodology, not project-specific implementation docs.

Pre-existing wiki output, explicitly flagged as STALE in CLAUDE.md (generated for a prior real-estate client with /noticias and /servicos routes that no longer exist) — all its markdown pages are currently deleted per git status and it must be regenerated, not trusted.
